verdict.rationale: The division's own pages name the Premier Business Services (PBS) account layer and offer step-by-step setup videos (docs-30, supp-1), and note that PBS serves frequent filers or shared payment accounts (docs-37), so one account prerequisite is published. Nothing states, before the flow begins, whether an account is mandatory for formation filing, or what credentials or identity-proofing are required. missing for 10: an upfront published list of required account/login steps for filing, credential requirements, identity-proofing (ID verification) steps, a statement of when these occur in the flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
